**Senior Manager, Incentives Strategy and Operations | Viator**


**About Tripadvisor**

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.


We are looking for an analytically rigorous, commercially minded, and execution-oriented leader to help shape and scale Tripadvisor’s incentives and loyalty portfolio.

This role will own the strategic and operational governance for how we evaluate, prioritize, and scale incentives across the business. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across Finance, Product, Data, CRM, Regional, and Marketing teams to turn complex program economics into clear recommendations, scalable processes, and better business decisions.  
You will play a critical role in helping the business answer some of its most important growth and profitability questions: Which incentives are truly incremental? Which audiences should we invest in? How do we balance conversion, customer value, margin, and cost discipline? And how do we build the operating model required to scale incentives responsibly across markets, channels, and customer segments?

This is a high-impact role for someone who can build structure from ambiguity, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and translate analysis into strategy, governance, and action. While execution teams will support campaign delivery, this role will be responsible for setting the strategic direction, operating cadence, measurement standards, and investment discipline that enable the incentives portfolio to scale effectively.


Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2-3 days per week in our London office.


**What You’ll Do**

**Shape the strategy and governance model for incentives and loyalty:**

* Develop the strategic framework for how Tripadvisor evaluates, prioritizes, and scales incentive and loyalty initiatives across the business.
* Define the principles and guardrails for when, where, and how incentives should be used, balancing growth, profitability, customer experience, and operational complexity.
* Partner with CRM, Product, Regional, Marketing, Data, and Finance teams to ensure incentive initiatives are aligned to broader business priorities.
* Help move the business from isolated campaigns and tests toward a more structured, scalable, and financially disciplined incentives portfolio.
* Establish clear operating rhythms for reviewing performance, making investment decisions, and prioritizing future opportunities.


**Build the financial and analytical backbone for incentives performance:**

* Own the framework for evaluating incentive and loyalty program performance, including redemption, incremental bookings, revenue impact, margin impact, customer lifetime value, cost-to-serve, and ROI.
* Partner closely with Finance to build and maintain reliable P&L reporting infrastructure for incentives and loyalty, including spend tracking, forecasting, cost visibility, and program-level economics.
* Support the department lead and Finance partners with the inputs needed for budget planning, investment trade-off discussions, and performance reviews.
* Establish reporting cadences, approval processes, and investment guardrails so incentive spend remains transparent, disciplined, and aligned to business objectives.
* Ensure leadership has a clear, trusted, and consistent view of incentive performance across programs, markets, channels, and customer segments.


**Turn insights into roadmap and investment decisions:**

* Lead recurring and ad hoc deep dives into program performance, customer segments, test results, cost drivers, and behavioral trends to identify what is working, what is not, and where the business should invest next.
* Translate complex analysis into clear strategic recommendations, business cases, and executive-ready narratives.
* Partner with Product, Data, CRM, Regional, and Marketing teams to shape the incentives roadmap, ensuring initiatives are prioritized based on expected impact, cost, feasibility, and strategic fit.
* Identify opportunities to improve incentive effectiveness through better targeting, program design, customer segmentation, channel coordination, and measurement.
* Help leadership understand trade-offs across short-term conversion, long-term customer value, margin impact, operational complexity, and strategic growth.


**Build scalable operating processes for cross-functional execution:**

* Design and improve the operating processes required to propose, approve, launch, measure, and review incentive initiatives.
* Create clear standards for how incentive programs are evaluated before launch and assessed after execution.
* Partner with execution teams to ensure campaign delivery is supported by strong strategic rationale, clear measurement plans, and appropriate financial guardrails.
* Help build a scalable test-and-learn discipline for incentives, enabling the business to move quickly while maintaining measurement rigor and financial accountability.
* Identify operational gaps, process inefficiencies, and areas of ambiguity that could limit the business’s ability to scale incentives effectively.


**Champion incentive economics across the business:**

* Serve as a key thought partner to Finance, Product, Data, CRM, Regional, and Marketing teams on how incentive investment translates into customer and business value.
* Own the metrics, narrative, and recommendations that feed into recurring business reviews and leadership updates on incentives and loyalty.
* Bring a structured, analytical perspective to strategic discussions, ensuring decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition or isolated campaign results.
* Act as a connective tissue across teams, ensuring incentives are managed as a disciplined business portfolio rather than a set of disconnected campaigns.


**What Success Looks Like:**

A successful candidate will help the business build a more structured, scalable, and financially disciplined approach to incentives and loyalty.

In this role, success means:

* Leadership has a clear and trusted view of incentive performance, spend, ROI, and business impact.
* Finance and business teams are aligned on how incentive economics are measured, reported, and forecasted.
* Incentive investment decisions are grounded in clear evidence, consistent measurement, and well-defined business trade-offs.
* Cross-functional teams have a repeatable operating model for proposing, launching, measuring, and scaling incentives.
* The incentives roadmap reflects the highest-value opportunities across customer segments, channels, markets, and product surfaces.
* Execution teams are supported by clear strategic direction, operating processes, and measurement standards.
* The business can scale incentives with greater speed, confidence, and financial control.
* Incentives become a more disciplined growth lever that supports both customer acquisition and long-term customer value.


**Required Skills & Experience**

* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
* Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset 
* 7+ years of experience in growth strategy, business operations, commercial strategy, go-to-market strategy, incentives, loyalty, pricing, performance marketing, financial planning and analysis, or management consulting.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience building or interpreting P&L models, ROI frameworks, forecasts, business cases, or investment recommendations.
* Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, interpret complex data, and translate insights into clear business decisions.
* Experience partnering with Finance, Data/Analytics, Product, Marketing, CRM, Regional, or Operations teams to build shared infrastructure and drive cross-functional alignment.
* Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to build crisp strategy documents, business reviews, and decision-ready presentations.
* Proven ability to influence without direct authority and drive progress across teams with different priorities, incentives, and levels of context.
* Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
* A structured problem-solving approach, with a bias toward action and a high bar for analytical rigor.


**Nice to have skills:**

* Experience in management consulting, business operations, growth strategy, go-to-market strategy, or commercial strategy roles.
* Experience working on loyalty, promotions, incentives, pricing, marketplace growth, customer lifecycle, or monetization programs.
* Experience with experimentation, incrementality measurement, customer segmentation, or lifetime value analysis.
* Familiarity with BI tools, SQL, dashboards, or analytics workflows.
* Experience building operating rhythms, governance processes, or scalable cross-functional planning mechanisms.
* Experience working in travel, marketplaces, e-commerce, consumer technology, or membership-based businesses.


**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
* “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
* Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
* Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
* Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
* Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
* Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
* Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
* Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
* Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.


**Our Cultural Pillars:**

**Traveler first**

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. 


**Execution is our edge**

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. 


**We succeed together**

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

# Senior Application Security Engineer

London, England, United Kingdom

**About TripleLift**

We're TripleLift, an advertising platform on a mission to elevate digital advertising through beautiful creative, quality publishers, actionable data and smart targeting. Through over 1 trillion monthly ad transactions, we help publishers and platforms monetize their businesses. Our technology is where the world's leading brands find audiences across online video, connected television, display and native ads. Brand and enterprise customers choose us because of our innovative solutions, premium formats, and supportive experts dedicated to maximizing their performance.

As part of the Vista Equity Partners portfolio, we are NMSDC certified, qualify for diverse spending goals and are committed to economic inclusion. Find out how TripleLift raises up the programmatic ecosystem at triplelift.com.

## **Overview**

The Senior Application Security Engineer plays a critical role in driving secure software development and application security maturity within TripleLift's Engineering and Security organization, directly influencing how we protect our advertising platforms and the trust our publishers and advertisers place in us. In this position, you will partner closely with Engineering, Platform, Cloud Infrastructure, and Security teams to shape secure coding practices, application security tooling, vulnerability remediation, and CI/CD security, ensuring security is embedded into how we design, build, deploy, and operate our products.This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants to build and scale an application security program at a company operating at the center of a rapidly evolving, high-stakes ad-tech landscape, while contributing meaningfully to the long-term security posture and resilience of the organization.

## **Responsibilities**

* Play a critical role in building and maintaining a global security compliance program based on NIST CSF.
* Scale application security by developing automated security testing utilizing enterprise SAST, DAST, and code-review tools.
* Champion SDLC to promote secure application development and infrastructure deployment and facilitate secure coding remediation activities.
* Automate security testing in CI/CD pipelines to detect vulnerabilities early, including building and maintaining the pipeline integrations themselves.
* Administer and drive adoption of GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS) : code scanning, secret scanning, and dependency review across engineering repositories.
* Participate in threat modeling and design/architecture spec reviews to identify and mitigate security risks early in the SDLC.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to develop and implement a vulnerability management program and to perform threat-hunting activities.
* Own and conduct internal penetration testing and vulnerability assessments of applications and infrastructure, and validate findings from third-party pentest engagements.
* Monitor and respond to application-layer security threats like API abuses, business logic flaws, and common web vulnerabilities.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure security is a key consideration in software design and architecture.
* Enhance application security posture by working with cross-functional teams to implement proper authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms.
* Enhance and facilitate security incident handling activities.
* Evangelize security best practices and provide education and awareness to company employees. Develop and implement secure coding guidelines and conduct secure development training for engineers.
* Evaluate and continuously improve the maturity of the security program through the deployment and management of various security tools and processes.

## **Education & Requirements**

* 5 years minimum of experience in application security, secure software development, security engineering, or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of secure coding practices and ability to guide developers on remediation strategies.
* Experience with GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS), including Code Scanning (SAST), Secret Scanning, and Dependency Review.
* Proficiency in SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., CodeQL, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, Checkmarx, Veracode).
* Hands-on experience integrating security testing tools into CI/CD pipelines for automated security scanning, including designing and building pipeline workflows.
* Hands-on penetration testing / offensive security experience across web applications, APIs, or cloud infrastructure.

## Description

The operations we automate run on work that has never been fully written down. There is usually a process document, and it usually describes the standard case. The parts that matter most sit with the people doing the work every day. That is why this work has resisted automation for so long, and why AI agents that can exercise judgement change what is possible.

As an AI Deployment Lead you own the deployment of our Virtual Agents end to end. You lead the customer through delivery, work out how their operation actually runs, agree what we are building and what we are not, and work alongside our Implementation Engineers to get it live and converted.

You are not a project coordinator. You are the person the customer trusts to understand their operation, and the person our engineers rely on to know what to build.

You'll join as our first AI Deployment Lead, working closely with product and engineering to build and mature the function, with an opportunity to step into a leadership role in future.

## Requirements

**About the role:**

* **Own deployments end to end.** Lead the engagement from kickoff through to a live, adopted automation. Set the plan, align stakeholders across operations, IT and the executive team, and hold everyone including the customer accountable to it
* **Discover how the work is really done.** Work alongside customer teams to understand the process as it exists rather than as it is documented: the volumes, the exceptions, the judgement calls, the decisions nobody wrote down. Turn that into a clear, agreed scope our engineers can build against and our customers recognise as their own. We're looking for people who are able to document the SOP, not only run the workshop
* **Advise on what to automate and what to leave.** Not every part of a process should be automated on day one. You make the trade-offs explicit, sequence what lands first, and make sure the customer understands what they're getting
* **Deliver alongside engineering.** Our Implementation Engineers own the technical design and build. You own the agreed customer outcome, scope and requirements, and you're close enough to the product to challenge a design, discuss access and integrations, and understand what's feasible
* **Define success and drive the decision.** Agree what good looks like and how it will be measured, capture the customer's baseline before we build, and lead the conversation that turns a pilot into a production service
* **Make the next deployment faster.** Turn what you learn into playbooks, patterns and product requirements. You're often the earliest signal on what our product needs to do next

**About you:**

* 5+ years in management, technology or transformation consulting, implementation or professional services, including time at AI Deployment Lead, Engagement Manager, Project Leader or equivalent level where you owned a programme end to end. We're looking for people who have run the engagement, not only staffed it

* Comfortable managing several deployments at once, with competing priorities and multiple stakeholder groups
* Technically fluent. You don't need to code, but you need to hold your own with engineers on integrations, access, data and feasibility
* Strong stakeholder presence. Comfortable with an operations team on Monday and an executive steering group on Tuesday, and able to build credibility quickly

The role will bring clear accountability to cash forecasting, treasury reconciliations, cash generation and regulatory capital monitoring/reporting across VFX’s UK and international operations.

The role sits alongside the Financial Controller and FP&A function and is intended to strengthen the Group’s control over cash, liquidity and regulatory-capital positions. The successful candidate will be hands-on, comfortable with detail and able to build robust, repeatable processes in an evolving regulated financial-services environment.

A key objective will be to move activities that have historically been performed inconsistently, intermittently or as side-desk projects into a properly owned and controlled function, supported by appropriate automation and management information.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

###### Treasury, Cash & Liquidity

* Own the Group cash forecasting process, including short-, medium- and longer-term cash forecasts.
* Forecast interest income and interest expense and incorporate relevant assumptions into the cash outlook.
* Monitor cash balances, liquidity and funding requirements across relevant Group entities and accounts.
* Provide clear reporting and escalation of actual or forecast liquidity constraints, excess cash and material cash movements.
* Support the CFO with cash-management decisions, banking relationships and treasury initiatives.

###### Regulatory Capital Monitoring & Reporting

* Own day-to-day monitoring and reporting of regulatory capital requirements across relevant entities and jurisdictions.
* Coordinate regulatory-capital submissions and supporting analysis, including FCA requirements for EMI / MiFID activities, DFSA Category 3D and MFSA requirements.
* Maintain clear regulatory-capital calculations, supporting evidence, review controls and sign-off processes.
* Monitor headroom against regulatory requirements and proactively flag emerging risks or breaches.
* Work closely with Compliance, Risk and external advisers where regulatory interpretation or reporting support is required.

###### Reconciliations & Cash Generation

* Own reconciliation of internal and house accounts and ensure breaks are investigated and cleared promptly.
* Own the reconciliation of profit sweeps and the cash-generation bridge from revenue through to free business cash.
* Work with Finance, Treasury, Operations and Commercial stakeholders to understand and explain material cash movements.
* Improve the control, consistency and visibility of cash-generation processes across the Group.

###### Controls, Processes & Automation

* Document and maintain clear procedures for treasury, cash forecasting, regulatory-capital monitoring and reconciliations.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet-led or fragmented processes and implement practical improvements and automation.
* Develop reliable management information and dashboards for cash, liquidity, regulatory capital and key reconciliations.
* Establish clear review, exception and escalation processes and ensure a strong audit trail is maintained.
* Support system and banking changes to ensure Treasury & Regulatory Finance requirements are considered before implementation.

###### Group Finance & Business Partnering

* Work closely with the Financial Controller and FP&A to ensure cash, profit, working-capital and regulatory-capital views reconcile.
* Provide treasury and cash insight for budgeting, forecasting, modelling and strategic decision-making.
* Support new entities, products, banking arrangements and international expansion from a treasury and regulatory-capital perspective.

* Understanding of regulated financial-services requirements, with experience supporting regulatory reporting or regulator-facing processes.
* Experience working with complex cash movements, bank accounts, reconciliations, liquidity reporting, or treasury controls.
* Experience building or improving finance, treasury, or operational processes from an imperfect starting point.

###### **Technical Skills**

* Able to reconcile complex cash movements and explain differences clearly to senior stakeholders.

As housing providers respond to rising customer expectations, stricter compliance requirements, asset investment pressures, building safety obligations, decarbonisation targets and the delivery of high-quality, affordable homes.  
  
The Job:  
  
The Housing Investment Service is responsible for the management and delivery of responsive and cyclical maintenance, specialist & compliance works, planned improvement works and refurbishment schemes to a stock of 24,000 domestic properties, garages and associated buildings and surroundings.  
  
The service is structured around key delivery areas, with teams responsible for Responsive Repairs, Voids, Gas Servicing & Repairs, Electrical, Planned Improvements, Asbestos, H&S, Asset, Finance, Customer Engagement, Contract Support, Home Ownership and Claims. All teams work closely together to provide a uniform and consistent service for all our customers and stakeholders.  
  
We are seeking a forward-thinking professional who can help shape our response to these challenges, work effectively with stakeholders and drive continuous improvement across our services.  
  
The Housing Investment, Asset Management team is seeking to recruit an exceptional Asset and Compliance Data Solutions Lead to help us adapt and change the way we manage our assets.   
  
This role will Lead on the migration of data and information into our ICT solution provided by NEC (formerly Northgate), develop standards and structures for data management and lead on the continual design of data and information within the solution to support operational and/or legislative requirements.   
  
This role is key to N&H, to assure data led decision making, particularly for the delivery of improvement programmes for example replacement windows, doors, kitchens and bathrooms, to allow information to be managed and shared appropriately for energy efficiency schemes and to ensure the safety of the properties and residents within our social housing estate.   
  
You will work collaboratively within teams across Neighbourhoods and Housing Service, ICT and with senior managers and officers to ensure that tenants needs and requirements are first and foremost in everything we build – and that these are thoroughly captured and embedded in the operational solution.   
  
You will have excellent skills in understanding business requirements through negotiation, communication, and empathy. You will be able to work within an Agile methodology.   
  
If the postholder requires a Standard or Enhanced DBS disclosure the candidate is required to declare full details of everything on their criminal record unless the conviction/s and/or caution/s are considered “protected” in line with filtering rules for DBS checks.  
  
ROLE AND PURPOSE  
  
Changes in legislation means that the Neighbourhoods & Housing Service needs to alter the way it manages its assets and safety procedures as detailed in the Social Housing White paper, Building Safety Act 2022, Fire Safety Act 2021, and the Golden Thread Regulations set out by the Department for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities (DLUHC).  
  
Central to compliance with the revised legislation will be the provision of robust data solutions to manage, integrate, report and share asset, safety, and compliance-related data, in a way that enables the service to effectively and efficiently manage relevant processes and gain assurance on the accuracy, validity and quality of the data. NEC housing and The Compliance Workbook (TCW) are essential to support asset management, performance management, and delivery of planned programmes of works and will require the post holder to: -   
  
• Lead on the design and implementation of an end-to-end solution that captures all relevant business requirements and complements new NEC Housing modules, and TCW with existing NEC modules/services, such as repairs, allocations, and adaptations  
• Working with NEC and Systems Team on integrations with other line of business systems to assure effective data sharing and the enrichment of asset/element information

• Lead on design of data and information within solutions to support data and information requirements identified operationally or in Legislation e.g. smoke/damp sensors and Building Safety Cases.

## Role Overview

This is an owner-side technical asset management role supporting the safe, reliable and commercially effective operation of the Lynn & Inner Dowsing Offshore Wind Farm. The successful candidate will act as the technical focal point between asset owners, contractors and service providers, combining practical offshore wind judgement with commercial awareness and governance discipline.

This position is ideally suited to an experienced offshore wind professional seeking to transition from operational delivery into owner-side asset management.

The role is not responsible for performing maintenance activities. Instead, the successful candidate will oversee, challenge and support the organisations that do, using technical evidence to protect asset value and improve operational outcomes.

The successful candidate will develop a detailed understanding of the technical condition, operational performance and risk profile of the asset and will play a key role in supporting owner decisions regarding performance, risk, expenditure and long-term value creation.

## Role and Responsibilities

**Asset Performance**

* Act as the owner-side technical lead for Lynn & Inner Dowsing Offshore Wind Farm.
* Develop and maintain a detailed understanding of the technical and operational condition of the wind farm, including wind turbines, electrical infrastructure, marine operations and supporting systems.
* Monitor production, availability, losses, technical performance and operational risk across the asset.
* Analyse SCADA data, operational reports, work orders and technical information to identify trends, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.
* Support the identification and implementation of operational improvement initiatives that enhance safety, reliability and asset value.

**O&M Oversight**

* Work closely with the O&M Contractor to ensure maintenance activities are delivered safely, effectively and in accordance with contractual obligations.
* Challenge contractor performance where appropriate using objective operational and technical evidence.
* Review maintenance plans, campaign strategies, outage planning and major interventions.
* Monitor contractor KPIs, performance guarantees, service quality and response times.
* Support contractor audits and performance reviews where required.

**Technical Risk & Reliability**

* Maintain awareness of emerging technical risks, reliability concerns and fleet-wide issues that could affect asset performance.
* Support root cause investigations relating to operational incidents, major defects and equipment failures.
* Review engineering modifications, technical recommendations and reliability improvement proposals.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of technical risk registers and mitigation plans.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong working relationships with asset owners, contractors, consultants and key industry stakeholders.
* Lead or support technical review meetings with contractors and specialist suppliers.
* Coordinate with commercial asset managers, HSE specialists, regulatory advisers and grid stakeholders where required.
* Support shareholder, board and client reporting through the provision of clear technical insight and recommendations.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Prepare and deliver monthly technical performance updates for asset owners.
* Present complex technical issues in a concise and commercially relevant manner.
* Support budgeting, forecasting and operational expenditure reviews relating to asset performance activities.
* Contribute to continual improvement of XceCo reporting products, asset management systems and technical processes.

**Site Engagement**

* Undertake periodic site visits, vessel visits and contractor engagement activities to maintain a practical understanding of asset condition and operational performance.
* Maintain visibility of offshore operational challenges and developing industry best practice.

## Qualifications and Experience

**Essential**

* Significant experience within the offshore wind industry.
* Experience as an Authorised Technician, Senior Technician, Production Engineer, Production Manager, Service Engineer, Operations Engineer or similar role on operational offshore wind farms.
* Strong understanding of offshore wind operational performance, maintenance activities and technical risk management.
* Experience interpreting operational reports, SCADA trends, technical data and maintenance records.
* Ability to engage confidently with technicians, engineers, contractors and senior stakeholders.
* Full UK Driving Licence.

**Desirable**

* Siemens SWT-3.6 experience.
* Experience working in owner-side asset management.
* Experience reviewing O&M agreements and performance obligations.
* Knowledge of balance of plant systems, substations, foundations, subsea assets, export systems or marine operations.
* Engineering degree, HNC, apprenticeship or equivalent technical qualification.

## Person Specification

* Technically credible with offshore delivery teams.
* Sound engineering judgement with a practical understanding of offshore wind operations.
* Naturally inquisitive, analytical and evidence-led.
* Comfortable challenging established views professionally and objectively.
* Able to understand how technical decisions influence commercial outcomes.
* Capable of working independently while contributing positively to a small, high-performing team.
* Confident presenting technical information to non-technical audiences.
* High levels of integrity, accountability and professionalism.

## Description

### About Zego

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has.

Good drivers are the entire point of Zego. Seven in 10 drivers on the road are consistently good, but until telematics came along there was no way to prove it, so nearly everyone paid a price based on averages. Zego is the company built to change that.

At Zego, we're leading the AI evolution in insurance.

We move fast, without the layers that usually slow things down. AI takes the routine work off every team, from Finance to Product to Marketing, so people ship real code and launch custom dashboards in minutes. Engineering commits are entirely AI-assisted, which shifts the focus from team size to the quality of your thinking, and our data warehouse connects directly to an AI assistant for instant answers. Backed by a modern tech stack (Claude Code, Snowflake, Figma and Zapier) and a commitment to adopting new tools in days rather than quarters, you get complete ownership to do the most impactful work of your career.

### **Purpose of role**

Reporting to the Third party and Complex Claims Manager, the Claims Handler will manage their own portfolio of motor cases, focusing on claims exceeding £100k including losses for injury, credit hire, vehicle and property damage. This position requires not only excellent communication and negotiation skills but also a deep understanding of liability, indemnity, and quantum issues to effectively drive down claims costs while ensuring fair compensation for injured claimants. The role also involves handling large loss claims and acting as a technical referral point to provide coaching, mentoring, and training to the claims handling teams.

**What you will be doing**

* Manage a personal portfolio of complex and high-value motor cases, setting accurate reserves at inception and maintaining a clear claims strategy from first notification to resolution.
* Communicate effectively with customers, witnesses, insurers, repairers, solicitors, and medical agencies to expedite claim resolutions.
* Participate in strategic projects to keep the team at the forefront of industry trends and performance, and contribute portfolio insights to inform product and underwriting decisions.
* Investigate liability disputes thoroughly, gathering and assessing evidence including CCTV, dashcam footage, police reports, and witness statements to build a defensible position; manage Road Traffic Act obligations and Motor Insurers' Bureau (MIB) claims where applicable.
* Critically evaluate and challenge all heads of damage - general damages, special damages, care and assistance, loss of earnings, future losses, and rehabilitation costs, applying relevant case law.
* Scrutinise medical evidence from treating and expert witnesses, challenging speculative or inflated prognoses and instructing counter-experts where appropriate.
* Negotiate settlements directly with claimant solicitors and defendants, targeting outcomes that are fair, defensible, and below reserve.
* Challenge inflated credit hire claims using evidence of basic hire rates, need, and impecuniosity; make sound total loss and repair decisions aligned with market valuations and engineering assessments.
* Conduct structured file reviews and one-to-one coaching sessions with the broader claims team, contributing to training materials, technical guidance notes, and best practice documentation.
* Handle all claims in line with FCA Consumer Duty obligations, maintaining thorough file documentation, clear audit trails, and adherence to reserving protocols and authority levels at all times.

**What you will need to be successful**

* Proven experience handling all types of motor claims, specifically those in excess of £100k.
* Specific experience in Personal Injury and Credit Hire motor claims.
* Strong knowledge of indemnity and liability, familiar with Civil Procedure Rules, Serious Injury Guide, The Rehabilitation Code, and litigation procedures.
* A passion for a career in Large Loss, with a commitment to ongoing technical development.
* You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

At Zego, we operate like a high-performing sports team. We come together as one, driven by ambition, backed by real support, and united by a shared mission to win.

Working here means having the backing, the coaching, and an inclusive community of Zegons across the UK and Europe who celebrate your wins and raise your game. It also means holding ourselves to high standards: moving with urgency, taking complete ownership, and embracing honest feedback that helps us continuously learn and evolve.

This is your opportunity for a career-defining experience, and one you will own.

.

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: we gather in our central London or Halifax office weekly. It is about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It is a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year...

If you're ready to help build the real-time, data-driven infrastructure for an intelligent world, we want to hear from you.
